description: Invert colors of a base64-encoded PDF (up to 2 MB) directly into a downloadable dark-mode PDF. For larger files or photo-preserving conversion (keeping photos in original colors), use https://pdfdark.org/invert-pdf-colors.

pdf_base64.description: Base64-encoded input PDF bytes (max 2 MB decoded).

theme.description: Dark background tint applied after inversion. Defaults to 'pure_invert'.

name: invert_pdf_base64
